record.label: Information-limit fork + integration laws (proof)
record.summary: Three laws that direct all remaining work: (1) the card's pair-state is INFORMATION-LIMITED — exact 2D Gram-Charlier consumption equals its series (0.99-1.01), so no richer formula on carried planes can close the residual (19th fence); (2) coadaptation at field level — exact sector patches overshoot many-fold; fixes must be wholesale or ride the consumption channel; (3) the DIFFERENCE-FIRST law — residuals are producible only as differences of matched models (why the certified chain works and every absolute construction graded ~0).
record.terminal_criterion: Closed by measurement+derivation from five independent directions (information probe, coadaptation overshoot, Mehler-slot surgery, absolute-Gram null, delta-model null).
record.goal_path_summary: Proved that the estimator's own summaries mathematically cannot contain the information needed to fix its variance errors — the fix must be computed from the network's weights — and established the only integration shape that works: corrections built as differences of matched models, fed through the existing consumption machinery.
